name: Please Don't DNF Beijing 2026

venue.name: Danling SOHO (丹棱SOHO)
venue.address: No.6 Danling Street, Haidian (海淀区丹棱街6号)

information:
Please check the competition website for more information.

This competition limits the number of registrations by event:

3x3x3 Blindfolded: 60
3x3x3 Fewest Moves: 60
4x4x4 Blindfolded: 30
5x5x5 Blindfolded: 30
3x3x3 Multi-Blind: 30
Each event will be based on first-come-first-served basis according to the order of registration, and 210 competitors will be the theoretical maximum of the number of registrations.
